plugin.name: Server commands
plugin.description: Save shell commands with :name parameters and run them on a server over ssh; the output shows as a terminal.
field.host.hint: An ssh alias from ~/.ssh/config (or user@host). OneDesk never asks for a password: use a key or the ssh agent.
note.ssh: Runs with bash on the server, from a temporary file (its standard input is empty); cancelling ends it there too. A :name is a parameter; its value is passed as data and never runs as a command.
error.empty: There is no command to run.
error.badHost: The server must be an ssh alias or host: letters, digits and . _ - @ : only, not starting with -.
error.badTimeout: The timeout must be a whole number of seconds from 1 to {max}.
error.badMaxLines: The line limit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
error.ssh: ssh could not run the command on {host}: {detail}
error.param.nul: The value of “{name}” contains a NUL character.
error.param.tooLong: The value of “{name}” is longer than {max} characters.
error.param.number: The value of “{name}” must be a number.
error.param.enum: The value of “{name}” is not one of its choices.
error.template: Parameters cannot be used safely in this command: {why}. Remove the :name parameters there or simplify the shell text.
template.arith: arithmetic that is not closed as bash would
template.openHeredoc: a here-document whose end line is missing
template.heredoc: a here-document body that cannot be read
error.param.unsafe: The value of “{name}” looks like an array index with a command in it ([…$(…)…]); it is refused.
error.param.arith: “{name}” is used in arithmetic, so its value must be a whole number.
failed.timeout: Stopped after {s} s: the timeout was reached.
failed.limit: Stopped at the line limit ({n} lines).
